srs: The case search system records PoliceOfficer, SearchQuery, SearchService, and CaseResult; each has an id attribute. Each PoliceOfficer can have zero or more SearchQuery records, and each SearchQuery belongs to exactly one PoliceOfficer. Each SearchQuery uses exactly one SearchService, and each SearchService serves zero or more SearchQuery records. Each SearchService manages one or more CaseResult records by composition, and each CaseResult belongs to exactly one SearchService. Each PoliceOfficer can reference zero or more CaseResult records, and each CaseResult can be referenced by zero or more PoliceOfficer records.
